file-dir.out:
DESCRIPTION
  Route a prompt to the opposite local coding agent

USAGE
  okra counsel [flags] [<prompt>]

ARGUMENTS
  prompt string    Inline prompt to send to the opposite agent (optional)

FLAGS
  --file, -f file            Read the prompt from a file
  --from choice              Override source detection (choices: claude, codex)
  --output-dir, -o string    Base directory for run artifacts
  --deep                     Use the deeper profile
  --dry-run                  Resolve the route and command without executing

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)

EXAMPLES
  # Send an inline prompt to the opposite agent
  okra counsel "Review the auth refactor for blind spots"

  # Run the deeper profile with a prompt file
  okra counsel --deep -f prompt.md

  # Read the prompt from stdin
  echo "Challenge this migration plan" | okra counsel
file-dir.err:
ERROR
  Invalid value for flag --file: "sub". Expected: Path is not a file: <DIR>/sub
